description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the WindowPlacement functionalities related to positioning and ensuring windows are on screen within a macOS application. It tests methods like centeredFrame, topRightFrame, and ensureOnScreen to verify their behavior with different bounds, padding, and window positions.

classes.name: WindowPlacementTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying window placement functions in macOS applications.

methods.name: `centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin`
methods.description: Tests that when zero bounds are passed to centeredFrame, it falls back to origin with the provided size.

methods.name: `centered frame clamps to bounds and centers`
methods.description: Verifies that centeredFrame clamps to the bounds and centers within the given rectangle.

methods.name: `top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin`
methods.description: Checks that topRightFrame defaults to origin when bounds are zero.

methods.name: `top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding`
methods.description: Ensures that topRightFrame respects bounds and applies the specified padding.

methods.name: `ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen`
methods.description: Tests that ensureOnScreen repositions a window outside visible screen bounds to a fallback position.

methods.name: `ensure on screen does not move visible window`
methods.description: Verifies that ensureOnScreen leaves windows that are already on screen unchanged.
